classification.question_topic: Asking if others are 'punished' for talking about Mall World; reports temporary loss of access/recall and lack of lucid control after posting about it
classification.skip_reason: No concrete dream scene described (no specific locations visited, sensory qualities, entities, or events). Describes meta-effects: loss of access to Mall World, normal day-to-day dreams, reduced recall, and inability to lucidly alter/transport.

meta.author_theory: After posting about Mall World, they are 'not allowed' to access it; dreams become mundane or not remembered; lack lucid abilities; believes it is beyond coincidence

interactions.description: After posting about Mall World for the past week, reports being 'not been allowed at mallworld' and instead having 'bullcrap normie dreams' involving 'day to day grind irl' or waking 'not allowed to remember anything'. Also reports 'zero lucid abilities' and inability to 'transport or change locations'.

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenology is meta-level (access/recall/control) rather than in-dream location descriptions. No extractable Mall World scenes, entities, lighting, cleanliness, geometry, or specific boundaries were provided.
